title: Item CRUD Create and List
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build an Express.js application with an in-memory array store and two endpoints: POST `/items` which accepts `{ "name": string }`, adds an item with an auto-incremented `id`, and returns the created item with status 201; and GET `/items` which returns the array of all items with status 200. If the POST body is missing `name`, return status 400 with `{ "error": "Name is required" }`.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Use Express.js
- Use in-memory array storage
- Auto-increment `id`
- Export the app with `module.exports = app`

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
